question: A class of 38 students took a Physics test. 14 students had an average score of 68. The remaining students had an average score of 73. What is the average score (rounded off to one decimal place) of the whole class?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining students = 38 − 14 = 24

Use weighted average:

Average = (14×68 + 24×73) ÷ 38

= (952 + 1752) ÷ 38 = 2704 ÷ 38

= 71.157... ≈ 71.2

**∴ Answer = 71.2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total students = 38

14 students → average = 68

Remaining 24 students → average = 73

**Formula used:**

Average = Total marks ÷ Total students

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total marks of 14 students = 14 × 68 = 952

⇒ Total marks of 24 students = 24 × 73 = 1752

⇒ Total marks = 952 + 1752 = 2704

⇒ Average = 2704 ÷ 38 = 71.157...

⇒ Rounded off = 71.2

**∴ The correct answer is 71.2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average

Average = (Σ f×x) ÷ Σ f

Combined Mean

Combined average = (n₁a₁ + n₂a₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂)

Shortcut Concept

Use weighted method instead of finding individual values

Rounding Rule

Round to one decimal place as per question requirement
